entries.name: Butchering

entries.name: Caffe
entries.definition: A deep learning framework from Berkeley AI Research, known for speed and modularity and used mostly for image tasks.

entries.name: Caffe2

entries.name: Cairngorm

entries.name: Cakewalk

entries.name: CANape

entries.name: Canon EOS flash systems

entries.name: Canvas LMS

entries.name: CanvasJS

entries.name: Capybara

entries.name: Cardiac stress testing

entries.name: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation
entries.definition: An emergency procedure that combines chest compressions and rescue breaths to keep blood and oxygen moving when someone's heart or breathing has stopped.

entries.name: Cardiothoracic surgery
entries.definition: The surgical specialty that operates on organs in the chest, mainly the heart and lungs.

entries.name: Cardiovascular coding
entries.definition: Assigning standard diagnosis and procedure codes to heart and blood-vessel care records for billing and reporting.

entries.name: Cardiovascular physiology
entries.definition: The study of how the heart and blood vessels work.
